issues.description: The problem text explicitly instructs students to implement the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) as public for easier testing, but both the provided template and the reference solution declare singFarmSongVerse as private. Additionally, the UML in the problem shows the method as private, creating an internal contradiction in the problem materials. This mismatch between the textual instruction and the template/solution visibility will confuse students about the required visibility and may cause tests or grading expectations to fail if they follow the text rather than the template.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement to remove the instruction that singFarmSongVerse must be public (and state it is a private helper as shown in the UML), or (B) change the template and reference solution to declare singFarmSongVerse as public (public void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)) so it matches the textual testing instruction. Choose the option that aligns with intended test access requirements.
